definitions.explanation: Describes uncomfortably hot and humid weather that makes one feel sticky and sweaty. A common description of Japanese summers.

examples.japanese: むしむし⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}れない→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧。
examples.english: I can't sleep on muggy nights.

examples.japanese: ⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧むしむし⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The muggy weather continues during the rainy season.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧むしむし⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けよう→開ける：00563_akeru⟧。
examples.english: It's muggy inside the room, so let's open the window.

examples.japanese: むしむし⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いて→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧、⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧⟦なし→無し：03779_nashi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{過|す}ごせない→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: The muggy days keep going, and I can't get by without air conditioning.

notes:
むしむし describes the uncomfortable combination of high heat and humidity typical of Japanese summers, especially during ⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧ (rainy season). The word evokes the feeling of sticky, oppressive heat.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦じめじめ→じめじめ：05789_jimejime⟧: damp (emphasizes moisture rather than heat)
- ⟦じとじと→じとじと：05939_jitojito⟧: humid/clammy
- ⟦{蒸|む}し{暑|あつ}い→蒸し暑い：03751_mushiatsui⟧: muggy/sultry (i-adjective form)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- むしむし⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be muggy
- むしむし⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧: muggy weather

SEASONAL USAGE:
Most commonly used in June-August, especially during the rainy season when humidity is at its peak.
